item.title: Queen's Domain: The Two-Person Hit
item.description:
A look at Queen's Domain, a retro first-person fantasy action RPG made by a two-person team. We cover the premise, how it plays, early reviews, and its strong first week of sales.

item.title: Psychiatry Weekly: Psilocybin NDA and Methadone After Overdose
item.description:
Compass Pathways completes its NDA for COMP360 in treatment-resistant depression, a Canadian cohort compares methadone and buprenorphine after overdose, and overdose deaths keep falling. Plus a quiet week in consultation-liaison and neuropsychiatry, and a round-up.

Sources:

  • NDA Submission Complete: COMP360 Psilocybin for Treatment-Resistant Depression
